items.headline: $X Exploit: Hacker Splits Loot Into Four 400-ETH Wallets
items.summary: The $X100 exploiter swapped ~4.75M USDT into ETH and split proceeds across four 400-ETH wallets, with 423 ETH still sitting in the distribution wallet. Onchain sleuths are watching every move.

items.headline: $LIBRA Case Dismissed: Judge Clears Milei of Fraud
items.summary: An Argentine judge ruled Milei's $LIBRA promo post didn't constitute 'criminally relevant deception,' dismissing the case against him and 10 others. The memecoin saga takes another wild turn.

items.headline: $CIRBTC Grabs 90% of Trading Volume on Arc
items.summary: Uniswap data shows $CIRBTC dominating Arc with 90% of trading activity — a sudden DEX volume surge worth watching as the new chain heats up.

items.headline: $AAVE Opens First Externally Curated V4 Markets
items.summary: $AAVE just launched its first externally curated V4 markets with Sentora, opening a new DeFi use case for third-party risk curators on the protocol.

items.headline: $ARB Hits Four-Week Low as Losses Outpace Market
items.summary: $ARB touched a four-week low, underperforming BTC and ETH, even as Arbitrum One's active addresses climbed. Capitulation or accumulation zone?
